title: Central-carbon FBA fluxes vs Toya 2010 (Pearson R = 0.728)
caption: Simulated central-carbon FBA fluxes correlate with Toya 2010 C13-MFA at R=0.728.
interpretation: Mean simulated central-carbon reaction fluxes vs Toya 2010 13C-MFA measurements correlate at Pearson R = 0.728 (p = 8.3e-5, 23 reactions). The baseline reproduces measured central-carbon flux distribution.
simulations: 2-seed x 2-gen wild-type baseline ensemble (showcase2-baseline-full), Ray-parallel, XArray/zarr + parquet emit.
